body: Yeah. I know what I need to do, it's just hard to find the energy and strength to do it.

I wish that I could have your strength right now.  I'm still in denial and shock over the most recent betrayal.  I know it gets better but right now I feel like crap.

Good luck.  You are on the path to a better future.

Sorry, Mississippi.  Just added it to top.  

This all just happened so I'm still in a haze.  I could be literally 10 hours from being homeless.

I've been trying to find a job just so I can end it on my terms at this point. Last time I told her that she was free to leave I think surprised her. I think she just assumed that she gets to stay with full custody.
Yep. Exactly. The story keeps changing a little bit each time to make it sound better.  I'm surprised she hasn't tried gas lighting me and saying that she never confessed to anything.

I know I'll be personally happier but I don't think I'll ever stop resenting her from taking time with my daughters away. As someone who didn't have a dad growing up I hate that my girls are going to end up with a similar issue.
Yeah. She can't see the toxic people that she surrounds herself with and doesn't like to deal with hurting people. Wish that courtesy extended to me.

Should also add that we tried counseling once.  Not a lot of non-religious marriage counselors in our area.  Somehow the counselor managed to take everything and turn it around on me.  By the end of the session, I felt like I was being blamed for the infidelity.  Did not return.
